items.source: Because ToolCallObservingAdvisor is at order HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 400 it is inserted after the auto-registered ToolCallingAdvisor (order HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 300) in the chain, so it participates in every tool-call iteration. ToolCallingAdvisor still filters tool-call chunks from what it returns to the outer chain, so the main caller receives only the final answer — the observing advisor handles the side-channel emission.
items.translation: 由于 ToolCallObservingAdvisor 的顺序为 HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 400，它被插入到链中自动注册的 ToolCallingAdvisor（顺序为 HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 300）之后，因此它会参与每一次工具调用迭代。 ToolCallingAdvisor 仍然会过滤其返回给外部链的工具调用分块，因此主调用者仅接收到最终答案——观察顾问（observing advisor）负责处理侧信道发射。

items.source: By default, memory advisors (DEFAULT_CHAT_MEMORY_PRECEDENCE_ORDER = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 200) are placed outside the tool-call loop. The ToolCallingAdvisor (at HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 300) manages conversation history internally across iterations. The memory advisor loads history once before the loop and persists only the final user/assistant exchange after it ends. This is the recommended setup because most ChatMemoryRepository implementations do not support tool-call message types.
items.translation: 默认情况下，记忆顾问（DEFAULT_CHAT_MEMORY_PRECEDENCE_ORDER = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 200）被放置在工具调用循环的外部。ToolCallingAdvisor（位于 HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 300）在迭代过程中内部管理对话历史。记忆顾问在循环开始前加载一次历史记录，并在循环结束后仅持久化最终的用户/助手交互。这是推荐的配置，因为大多数 ChatMemoryRepository 实现都不支持工具调用消息类型。

items.source: As an alternative to driving the loop manually, you can place a custom advisor inside the ToolCallingAdvisor loop by giving it an order value greater than ToolCallingAdvisor.DEFAULT_ORDER (e.g. HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 400). Such an advisor is invoked on every iteration of the tool-calling loop, not just once at the end, which means it has access to all intermediate messages:
items.translation: 作为手动驱动循环的替代方案，您可以通过为自定义 advisor 分配大于 ToolCallingAdvisor.DEFAULT_ORDER（例如 HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 400）的顺序值，将其放置在 ToolCallingAdvisor 循环内部。 此类 advisor 会在工具调用循环的每一次迭代中被调用，而不仅仅是在结束时调用一次，这意味着它可以访问所有的中间消息：

items.source: Use the .disableInternalConversationHistory() method only when placing a memory advisor inside the tool-call loop (order above ToolCallingAdvisor.DEFAULT_ORDER). The memory advisor then handles history on every iteration. Note that only InMemoryChatMemoryRepository supports persisting tool-call messages; other repositories should use the default outside-loop setup above.
items.translation: 仅当将 memory advisor 放置在工具调用循环内部（顺序高于 ToolCallingAdvisor.DEFAULT_ORDER）时，才使用 .disableInternalConversationHistory() 方法。此时，memory advisor 将在每次迭代中处理历史记录。请注意，只有 InMemoryChatMemoryRepository 支持持久化工具调用消息；其他存储库应使用上述默认的循环外设置。

items.source: Recursive advisors are a special type of advisor that can loop through the downstream advisor chain multiple times. This pattern is useful when you need to repeatedly call the LLM until a certain condition is met, such as:
items.translation: 递归顾问（Recursive advisors）是一种特殊的顾问类型，可以多次循环遍历下游顾问链。 当您需要反复调用 LLM 直到满足特定条件时，此模式非常有用，例如：

items.source: The ToolCallingAdvisor includes a conversationHistoryEnabled configuration option that controls how conversation history is managed during tool calling iterations.
items.translation: ToolCallingAdvisor 包含一个 conversationHistoryEnabled 配置选项，用于控制在工具调用迭代过程中如何管理对话历史。

items.source: In streaming mode — it receives the model’s raw chunk stream for each iteration, including tool-call request chunks, before ToolCallingAdvisor filters them out of the outbound stream.
items.translation: 在流式模式下 —— 它接收模型在每次迭代中的原始分块流（包括工具调用请求分块），随后 ToolCallingAdvisor 会将它们从出站流中过滤掉。

items.source: In the call path — the conversation history passed in each subsequent request includes the ToolResponseMessage(s) from the previous iteration, so the advisor observes both tool-call requests and their responses.
items.translation: 在调用路径中 —— 传递给后续每个请求的对话历史包含前一次迭代中的 ToolResponseMessage(s)，因此顾问可以同时观察到工具调用请求及其响应。

items.source: This approach keeps the tool-calling loop fully managed by the framework while still giving you complete visibility into every intermediate step, and it pairs naturally with the conversationHistoryEnabled and memory advisor patterns described in Conversation History Management.
items.translation: 这种方法让框架完全管理工具调用循环，同时仍能让您清晰地看到每一个中间步骤，并且它与 Conversation History Management 中描述的 conversationHistoryEnabled 和 memory advisor 模式自然结合。

items.source: The CallAdvisorChain.copy(CallAdvisor after) method is the key utility that enables recursive advisor patterns. It creates a new advisor chain that contains only the advisors that come after the specified advisor in the original chain and allows the recursive advisor to call this sub-chain as needed. This approach ensures that:
items.translation: CallAdvisorChain.copy(CallAdvisor after) 方法是实现递归 Advisor 模式的关键工具。 它会创建一个新的 Advisor 链，该链仅包含原始链中指定 Advisor 之后的 Advisor，并允许递归 Advisor 根据需要调用此子链。 这种方法确保了：

items.source: The ToolCallingAdvisor implements the tool calling loop as part of the advisor chain, rather than relying on the model’s internal tool execution. This enables other advisors in the chain to intercept and observe the tool calling process.
items.translation: ToolCallingAdvisor 将工具调用循环作为顾问链（advisor chain）的一部分来实现，而不是依赖模型的内部工具执行。这使得链中的其他顾问能够拦截并观察工具调用过程。

items.source: Loops through the advisor chain until the ToolExecutionEligibilityChecker reports no more tool calls
items.translation: 循环遍历顾问链，直到 ToolExecutionEligibilityChecker 报告不再有工具调用为止。

items.source: Supports "return direct" functionality - when a tool execution has returnDirect=true, it interrupts the tool calling loop and returns the tool execution result directly to the client application instead of sending it back to the LLM
items.translation: 支持“直接返回”功能——当工具执行包含 returnDirect=true 时，它将中断工具调用循环，并将工具执行结果直接返回给客户端应用程序，而不是将其发送回 LLM。

items.source: Supports configurable conversation history management via conversationHistoryEnabled
items.translation: 支持通过 conversationHistoryEnabled 配置对话历史管理

items.source: Supports a pluggable ToolExecutionEligibilityChecker to customize when the loop iterates
items.translation: 支持可插拔的 ToolExecutionEligibilityChecker，用于自定义循环迭代的时机。

items.source: By default (conversationHistoryEnabled=true), the advisor maintains the full conversation history internally during tool call iterations. This means each subsequent LLM call in the tool calling loop includes all previous messages (user message, assistant responses, tool responses).
items.translation: 默认情况下（conversationHistoryEnabled=true），顾问在工具调用迭代过程中会在内部维护完整的对话历史。这意味着在工具调用循环中的每一次后续 LLM 调用都包含所有之前的消息（用户消息、助手响应、工具响应）。

items.source: By default, ToolCallingAdvisor is auto-registered and manages the entire tool-calling loop internally — the caller only receives the final LLM answer. When you need full control over the loop (for example, to stream intermediate progress to a UI, add custom observability, or apply conditional logic between iterations), you can opt out of the auto-registered advisor and drive the loop yourself.
items.translation: 默认情况下，ToolCallingAdvisor 会自动注册并在内部管理整个工具调用循环——调用者仅接收到最终的 LLM 回答。 当您需要完全控制该循环时（例如，将中间进度流式传输到 UI、添加自定义可观测性或在迭代之间应用条件逻辑），您可以选择退出自动注册的 advisor 并自行驱动循环。
